candidates.idea: Extend mover track retention time and use velocity vectors for evasion direction
candidates.for: longer tracks improve velocity accuracy; perpendicular steering increases separation rate
candidates.risk: overfitting to transient mover motion, but static clearance checks mitigate static collisions

candidates.idea: During evasion, prioritize commands moving perpendicular to mover velocity vector
candidates.for: directly maximizes rate of separation when mover approaches
candidates.risk: may increase static collision risk if velocity vector misinterpreted
already tested (turn 7: 0/3 pass); may cause unnecessary evasion

diagnosis.chosen: Extend mover track retention time and use velocity vectors for evasion direction, as it addresses root cause (poor tracking) and improves evasion effectiveness
diagnosis.direction:
1. Increase track retention from 0.4s to 2.0s in _update_tracks to keep mover tracks longer for accurate velocity estimation.
2. In _choose during evasion, compute desired heading perpendicular to mover velocity vector (v: vx, vy) → desired heading = atan2(vx, -vy).
3. Add score bonus for commands whose yaw change aligns with this desired heading (e.g., bonus = _LAT_PRIO_W * cos(desired_heading - w)).
4. Ensure static clearance (stc) ≥ 0.0 remains required but prioritize lateral movement when mover is approaching (closing speed > 0).
5. Reduce _EVADE_MAX to 4.0s to limit prolonged ineffective evasion.
6. Increase _LAT_PRIO_W to 4.0 to strengthen lateral movement incentive during evasion.
